venues.name: Riverside Inn
venues.coverage: Jan-Dec 2025 via Visit Somerset county calendar; no 2026 listings found
venues.notes: Thursday acoustic + Saturday band nights; posted every week to the county calendar in 2025, then stopped. Own site/socials not found.

venues.name: Willie McBride's

venues.notes: Irish pub on Rt 202; also comedy nights. Only nights the pub posted to the county calendar are captured.

venues.name: Green Knoll Grill
venues.notes: Has a patio "Summer Stage"; cover/tribute bands.

venues.name: 22 West Tap and Grill
venues.notes: Cover bands on some Saturdays.

venues.name: The Bernie at the Bernards Inn
venues.notes: Supper-club music room at the Bernards Inn; mix of solo and bands.

venues.name: The Ross Farm
venues.notes: Historic barn concert series (mostly touring singer-songwriters) plus annual Ross Farm Jazz Fest (student ensembles + pros).

venues.name: The Landing
venues.notes: Duo nights occasionally posted.

venues.name: Village Brewing Company
venues.notes: "Underground" basement room is nearly all DJ/party nights; only two band nights found.

venues.name: The Rock Shack

venues.name: Downtown Somerville (Division St / Main St stages)

venues.name: Brook Arts Center
venues.notes: Mostly tribute shows, orchestra, theater, film; tribute acts without a band name skipped.

venues.name: Somerset County Park Commission Summer Concert Series

venues.notes: Free Sunday evening series plus July fireworks shows; mostly tribute/cover bands.

venues.name: Franklin Township Summer Gazebo Concerts
venues.notes: Friday gazebo series; full lineup not posted.

venues.name: White Oak Park festivals (Branchburg)
venues.coverage: 2025-2026 via county calendar; only the Oct 2025 Firemen's Oktoberfest named bands
venues.notes: Food Truck & Music Festivals (May/Aug), Country Fair, Harvest & Hops - bands rarely named.

venues.name: Shedfest (Fairview Farm Wildlife Preserve)
venues.notes: Raritan Headwaters fundraiser with local bands.

venues.name: Flounder Brewing

venues.notes: Fri acoustic soloists + Sat bands, "Flounder's House" touring songwriters, Irish session and open mic (not counted).

venues.name: Mannion's Pub & Restaurant
venues.coverage: county calendar only (St Patrick's, solo acoustic)
venues.notes: No named bands found.

venues.name: Chimney Rock Inn
venues.notes: Only Oktoberfest listings; no bands named.

venues.name: North Plainfield Summer Concert Series (Vermeule Community Center)
venues.notes: Lineup not published online.

venues.name: Iron Peak Sports & Events
venues.notes: Occasional patio music (soloists) and a Sep 2026 food & music festival with unnamed bands.

venues.name: Watchung Arts Center
venues.notes: Valentine jazz quintet (unnamed group).

venues.name: Duke Farms
venues.notes: No band events found 2025-26.

venues.name: Triumph Brewing Company (Princeton)
venues.notes: Fri/Sat jazz combos (leader-named trios/quartets, many NYC/Philly players).

venues.name: Princeton Shopping Center Summer Concert Series
venues.notes: Friday courtyard series with Triumph beer garden.

venues.name: Princeton Public Library (Hinds Plaza / Community Room)

venues.notes: Student ensembles and solo singer-songwriters skipped.

venues.name: Small World Coffee

venues.notes: Mostly solo singer-songwriters (skipped).

venues.notes: National touring tribute acts mostly.

notes: Somerset County coverage rests on the Visit Somerset NJ tourism calendar (Tribe Events REST API, all 3,213 events 2025-26), so bars appear only for nights they chose to post; Riverside Inn posted weekly in 2025 then stopped. Somerset County Park Commission and Bandsintown block fetching (403/Cloudflare); park dates came from search snippets. Wayback Machine was rate-limited (429) during this run. Leader-named jazz combos (Triumph Princeton, Tavern on George) are counted as bands; variant billings (Trio/Quartet/Quintet) of one leader merged. Solo artists, DJs, open mics, school/community ensembles and unnamed tribute shows skipped. Not reached: Trenton bars (Trenton Social, Mill Hill Basement, McManimon's) have no online calendars; 1867 Sanctuary blocked; River Horse site compromised; Court Tavern/Veganica and New Brunswick basements social-only; Downtown Somerville Summer Stage 2025-26 per-date bands not published; Mercer County Park/PSC/PPL/Porchfest/Small World/Man Cave/Triumph re-crawled with all single appearances. Small World and Lawrenceville years inferred from weekday matches. Randy Now's and Mercer County Park are mostly national/tribute acts.
